info.name: Khemra Knowledge RAG & Catalog API
info.description: Complete Postman collection for the Khemra RAG API (Ingestion, Multi-signal Vector Search, and Details) and Catalog API. Includes automated test scripts to capture knowledge_id into collection variables.

request.description: Upload a PDF document with page ranges and direct file URLs.
Upload a document using legacy base64 file_data (stored directly in DB BinaryField).
Searches across video segments. Matches segment 1 of the onboarding video and returns start_time_seconds, end_time_seconds, and matched_source with file_url.
Performs search with language='km'. If the Khmer source exists, matched_source returns the Khmer video file_url (is_fallback: false); otherwise falls back to English (is_fallback: true).
Performs AI embedding search matching PDF segments and returns page_start, page_end, and file_url.
Search using customized scoring weights for question, keyword, summary, and topic vectors.
Fetches complete knowledge record including all sources (with file_url and duration_seconds/page_count) and all segments with timestamps and keywords.
